simple.meaning: חֲמוֹר (chămôwr) appears 96 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with flocks. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 15 more, beginning at Genesis 12:16. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, flock, offering, city, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲמוֹר (H2543) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows חֲמוֹר through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
